self_contained_image.runtime_identity_method: containerd and runc are copied out of the node image with `docker cp`; the harness proves the copied bytes equal the binaries running inside the node by SHA-256

isolation.network_isolation_method: the node runs on a dedicated `docker network create --internal` bridge; the harness proves egress is unreachable from inside the node before applying any fixture Pod

observable_schema.rule: Observables are compared by canonical JSON digest. They contain only externally observable Kubernetes API state (Pod phase, container statuses, Event reasons and messages) and runtime ordering. Timestamps, UIDs, node names, and IPs are never part of an observable; raw timestamps belong to the trace.

init_sidecar_app_order.operations: ordered list of `create:<container>`, `start:<container>`, `wait:<init-container>` derived from container runtime createdAt/startedAt/finishedAt; expected create:prepare, start:prepare, wait:prepare, create:sidecar, start:sidecar, create:app, start:app
init_sidecar_app_order.phase: Pod phase once the app container is running

status.initContainerStatuses: [{name, state (waiting|running|terminated), restartCount, ready, started?, exitCode?}] in spec order
status.containerStatuses: [{name, state, restartCount, ready, started}] in spec order

liveness.kill_message: Container app failed liveness probe, will be restarted

restart_policy_and_backoff.restartCount: {variant => restartCount at the settle point: 2 for restarting variants, 0 for terminal variants}
restart_policy_and_backoff.phase: {variant => Pod phase at the settle point}
restart_policy_and_backoff.status: {variant => {state, reason, exitCode?, lastState?, lastReason?, lastExitCode?}} of the single app container at the settle point
restart_policy_and_backoff.backoff_seconds: {restarting variant => [first, second]} CrashLoopBackOff delays rounded to the nearest 10 seconds

graceful_termination_oracle.operations: ordered list: exec:preStop, signal:TERM, wait:<terminationGracePeriodSeconds>, signal:KILL derived from the termination message lines and exitCode 137 after the grace period
graceful_termination_oracle.events: ordered distinct Event reasons for the Pod recorded after the delete request (expected ["Killing"])
graceful_termination_oracle.phase: last Pod phase observed before the object disappears
